page.content:
Central Asian dynasty that midwifed Buddhism into the Tarim and China.

How Kushan Empire connects

  • Event: Buddhism transmission — Kushan patronage carried Buddhism toward the Tarim and China.
  • Faction: Yuezhi — Yuezhi groups in Bactria became the Kushan dynasty.

What is Kushan Empire?

The Kushans, heirs of the Yuezhi, ruled a zone from Bactria to northern India. Their coins and monasteries are a main vehicle of the first great Buddhist transmission north and east.

Key threads lead to Buddhism transmission and Yuezhi.
